verdict.rationale: Amplitude's docs describe a shared identity model across all SDKs, so a user instrumented once is recognized everywhere. This loosely supports identifying users across devices and platforms. Nothing in the pack documents merging anonymous pre-signup activity into an identified profile. Missing for 10: documentation of anonymous-to-identified merging (aliasing/device ID to user ID stitching), explicit cross-device identity resolution mechanics, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can identify users across devices and merge anonymous pre-signup activity into their identified profile

citations.quote: Every SDK shares the same identity, event, and consent model, so a user instrumented once is understood everywhere.
